items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: And Dizzy, Charlie Parker and other musicians I just can't remember right now.

ctx.x: But it was music, though. It had some foundation. Guys with good names, good musicians. This guy, a piano player, Thelonious Monk, all during that time Thelonious Monk. And Dizzy, Charlie Parker and other musicians I just can't remember right now. But you had a lot of them.
Now, let's... You worked in Chicago with Art Hodes around 1950. Did you go to Chicago with Hodes? Or did he send for you? Was he out there already at that time? How did you end up in Chicago?
